name: APIVerveUsernameProfanity
summary: Username Profanity flags offensive or inappropriate usernames before they reach your database.
description:
Username Profanity flags offensive or inappropriate usernames before they reach your database. Send any candidate handle to receive a clear true or false profanity check result.

This iOS/macOS SDK provides a convenient way to access the Username Profanity from APIVerve.
Supports both callback-based and async/await patterns.
